zh-CN: 产品显示名改为「青墨」：macOS 应用包、Windows 安装器/开始菜单/安装目录、Linux 启动器统一使用中文名；英文界面保留 Qingmo 拉丁名。
新增中文/英文运行时界面切换，原生菜单、对话框、关于窗口与更新提示会随语言同步。
新增外部修改自动感知：文档被其他程序改动时给出提示，保存前仍会检查磁盘版本冲突。
修复 Windows 通过文件关联打开 Markdown 时窗口空白的问题。
修复编辑器垂直滚动条与窗口右边框之间的空隙。
首次提供 Windows NSIS 与 Linux AppImage/deb 安装包；macOS 继续提供 universal DMG，自动更新清单覆盖四个平台。
迁移提示：旧版 Qingmo（Windows `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Qingmo`、macOS `Qingmo.app`）不会自动改名，首次升级后请卸载旧版或手动删除旧快捷方式；Linux deb 包名仍为 `qingmo`。
en-US: Renamed the product to 青墨: the macOS app bundle, Windows installer/Start menu/install directory, and Linux launcher now use the Chinese name; the English UI keeps Qingmo as the Latin name.
Added runtime Chinese/English UI switching; native menus, dialogs, the About window and update prompts follow the selected language.
Added external-change awareness: the app notices when a document is modified on disk by another program and still checks for version conflicts before saving.
Fixed a blank window when opening Markdown through Windows file associations.
Fixed the gap between the editor's vertical scrollbar and the window's right edge.
First Windows NSIS and Linux AppImage/deb packages; macOS continues to ship a universal DMG, and the update manifest now covers all four platform keys.

Migration: existing Qingmo installs (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Qingmo` on Windows, `Qingmo.app` on macOS) are not renamed automatically; uninstall the old version or remove the old shortcut after upgrading. The Linux deb package name remains `qingmo`.

zh-CN: 应用标识改为 com.wavexzore.qingmo，消除 macOS 将其末段误认为应用包扩展名的冲突。
升级后应用标识变化，偏好设置与缓存会重置一次。
签名、公证与自动更新校验链路保持不变。
en-US: Changed the bundle identifier to com.wavexzore.qingmo, removing the macOS conflict that treated its last segment as an app-bundle extension.
The bundle identifier changed, so preferences and caches reset once after upgrading.
Signing, notarization and update verification are unchanged.

zh-CN: 首个公开版本：本地优先的 Markdown 编辑器，文档始终保存在本机。
Live Preview 覆盖完整 Markdown 语法，含表格、数学公式、脚注、TOC、frontmatter 与 Mermaid 图版。
支持多窗口编辑、系统「打开方式」、原生中文菜单与应用内自动更新。
新增「关于」窗口与本地 macOS 发布链路（签名、公证、latest.json 验签）。
en-US: First public release: a local-first Markdown editor that keeps every document on your machine.
Live Preview covers the full Markdown syntax, including tables, math, footnotes, TOC, frontmatter and Mermaid diagrams.
Multi-window editing, Finder "Open With", a native Chinese menu, and in-app auto-update.
New About window and a local macOS release pipeline with signing, notarization and latest.json verification.
